strongest_angle: Examine the 7-square-kilometer disputed territory of Gornja Siga on the Danube River where Vít Jedlička founded the micronation of Liberland in 2015 amidst ongoing border tensions between Croatia and Serbia.

key_facts.fact: In 2014, Czech politician Vít Jedlička identified a 7-kilometer-squared terra nullius known as Gornja Siga on the west bank of the Danube River.
The Free Republic of Liberland is situated on a 7 square kilometer parcel located between Croatia and Serbia near the towns of Zmajevac and Bački Monoštor.
Liberland was founded in 2015 as a sovereign state by president Vít Jedlička, though Croatia views the claim as an attack on its territorial integrity.
